## 油價急升，長債標售強勁仍擋不住賣壓

油價急升，市場進一步押注聯準會升息；財政部首次擴大買回美債，實際承接金額又低於上限，美債因而大幅下跌。2年期殖利率上升13個基點至4.56%，5年期上升14個基點至4.75%，10年期上升12個基點至4.95%，30年期上升9個基點至5.37%。短端承受較大賣壓，2年與30年期利差收窄4個基點至81個基點。

布蘭特原油升至$108.85，WTI升至$103.78。生產者物價指數（PPI）反映能源成本上漲；核心月增率雖低於預估，機票與醫療費用的漲幅卻意味著，個人消費支出物價指數（PCE）的相關分項可能偏強。初領失業救濟金人數維持穩定，勞動市場也沒有出現足以讓聯準會暫緩處理通膨的新弱訊。歐洲央行同日升息並上調通膨預測，進一步加重全球債市壓力。

長債標售本身仍有強勁需求。$220億30年期美債的得標殖利率，比標售前市場交易水準低2.7個基點，交易商分配占比更創新低。不過，隨後財政部面對$105億賣回報價，只接受$51.9億，未用滿$60億額度，令期待官方擴大承接的投資人失望。標售帶來的支撐，最終不足以抵銷油價與政策重新定價的賣壓。

10年期實質殖利率上升9個基點至2.55%，漲幅大於同天期損益兩平通膨率的3個基點，後者收在2.40%。美國高收益債利差小幅擴大，市政債則同時面臨大量新券、再投資資金偏少及基金贖回的壓力。企業融資並未停擺，但財務較弱的借款人，必須用更高收益、額外擔保或更嚴格的債權保障換取資金。

## 燃料、穩定就業與選擇性買回推動重新定價

伊朗威脅，若美軍持續攻擊，將擴大戰事並加強反擊。《華爾街日報》報導，JD Vance與Marco Rubio曾警告川普，衝突可能延續至其任期結束，與川普宣稱戰爭將在選後立即結束形成對比。荷姆茲海峽攻擊持續，油市最迫切的問題仍是供應中斷，而非需求突然轉強。

交易員與Vortexa估計，不計液化石油氣，荷姆茲海峽每日成品油運量至少約100萬桶，仍遠低於戰前約400萬桶；原油運量則恢復至約戰前一半。中東至中國航線的油輪日收益接近$80萬，美國灣岸至亞洲的包船報價達創紀錄的$2,950萬。後者尚未計入額外戰爭風險與延誤成本，運費就已接近每桶$15。

美國庫存數據稍微緩解供應疑慮。原油庫存減少39.1萬桶，小於預估的160萬桶與前次的445萬桶降幅；汽油庫存增加126.9萬桶，原先預期減少140萬桶，餾分油則增加208.7萬桶，原估減少70萬桶。債市收盤後，沙烏地阿拉伯向OPEC表示，8月產量已降至1990年以來最低；胡塞武裝也向鄰近曼德海峽的紅海地區推進，讓供應風險延續至下一個交易時段。

8月PPI月增0.4%，符合預期，前兩個月則分別為7月修正後增加0.1%、6月減少0.1%。年增率由修正後的4.8%升至5.4%，高於市場預估的5.3%。商品價格上漲1.1%，其中能源上漲4.2%、柴油大漲24.1%，服務價格僅上漲0.1%。排除食品與能源的核心PPI月增0.2%，低於預估及7月修正值的0.3%；核心年增率則由4.3%升至4.6%，符合預期。若再排除貿易服務，月增率為0.3%、年增率為4.7%，前期分別為0.4%與4.7%。

不過，與PCE計算相關的細項並不溫和。機票、住院及門診費用明顯上漲，法律服務價格增加1.7%，創2009年有紀錄以來最大漲幅。醫療與機票漲幅超出預期，使Bloomberg Economics上調對8月PCE的估計。電子零組件與配件價格上漲3.4%，電腦及設備上漲0.2%，建築成本近乎不變，批發與零售利潤則下降0.2%。成本壓力並非全面擴散，但部分服務及AI相關投入仍持續變貴。

截至9月5日當週，初領失業救濟金人數為20.6萬人，略高於預估的20.5萬人，前期則上修至20.7萬人；四週移動平均減少1,500人至20.6萬人。截至8月29日當週，續領人數由修正後的177.5萬人降至177.4萬人，低於預估的178萬人，受保失業率維持1.2%。

房市表現較弱。成屋銷售由前期年化406萬戶減少2%至398萬戶，符合預期，卻是逾一年來最慢的銷售速度；房價中位數仍年增1.6%至$429,100。待售房屋增加5.9%至162萬戶，創2019年11月以來新高，相當於4.9個月的銷量，為逾十年最高。南部、中西部與東北部銷售均下降，西部持平，其中南部減少1.6%至年化184萬戶。首購族占比由7月的29%升至30%；購屋負擔能力雖較去年改善3.5%，仍處於歷史偏低水準。

Freddie Mac的30年期房貸利率由6.71%升至6.76%，高於去年的6.35%，並創2025年6月以來新高；15年期利率則由6.04%升至6.09%。全美不動產經紀人協會的Lawrence Yun表示，就業與薪資仍支持購屋需求。Barclays指出，住宅建築就業雖下降，非住宅專業建築與工程就業增加，卻使8月整體建築就業創新高。大型雲端業者已將逾90%的營運現金流投入AI，該行認為融資成本再增加50至75個基點，不太可能逆轉這些投資計畫。

稍晚的利率交換定價顯示，9月升息機率接近70%，至10月則已完全反映一次升息。30年期美債標售得標殖利率為5.308%，比市場低2.7個基點，是五年來第二大的標售溢價；交易商僅分配到2.2%，為所有一般美債標售最低。但財政部隨後只買回$51.9億，與先前該天期區間25次操作均用滿$20億額度不同。買回結果公布後，美債相對利率交換走便宜，20年期尤其明顯。

TD的Molly Brooks認為，財政部此次挑選報價比平常更嚴格。Bessent在收盤後訪問中表示，只會在價格具吸引力時買入，並稱持有人希望保留長債。這番說明突顯，買回額度並非必然用滿；當日市場原先對官方承接量的期待更高。

川普另提議，若共和黨在11月3日保住國會，將向每位成年公民發放$5,000。路透估計約2.4億人符合資格，總成本達$1.2兆。Vance提到以關稅收入支應，但國會預算辦公室資料顯示，本財年累計關稅收入僅$1,670億，赤字則達$2.1兆。方案仍需國會批准，共和黨先前也拒絕過類似提議；Ted Cruz則提出附帶工作要求的退稅方案。期貨最初反應平淡，但如此規模的支出承諾仍增加中期財政不確定性。

截至下午4點，市政債10年期基準殖利率上升15個基點至3.69%，創2025年4月以來新高；30年期上升14個基點至4.89%，創2011年2月以來新高。阿拉巴馬州Toll Road, Bridge and Tunnel Authority為Mobile River項目發債約$38億，紐約交通機構則發行約$7.78億豪宅稅支持債。摩根大通指出，新券供給、再投資資金偏少及稅務相關交易共同施壓，週三資金流出約$4.6億，為2025年4月以來最大。

## 歐洲央行升息，各國衡量能源之後還要走多遠

歐洲央行一致決議將存款利率提高25個基點至2.5%，為戰爭爆發以來第二次升息。新預測將2026年通膨率列為3%、2027年為2.5%、2028年為2.1%，其中後兩年的整體及核心通膨預測均上修，經濟成長預測也提高至0.9%。總裁拉加德表示，第2季各部門普遍擴張的情況，可能延續至第3季；能源成本則會逐步傳導至食品與核心物價。

但央行並未忽略成長下行風險。8月整體通膨率雖達3.3%，基礎物價、服務價格與薪資壓力卻有所降溫。知情人士表示，官員預期仍需升息，但認為市場反映的另外三次升息可能過多，目前也沒有承諾固定的升息時程。

德國10年期殖利率上升6個基點至3.50%，創2009年以來新高；2年期一度上升14個基點至3.21%。法國相對德國公債的利差盤中擴大至91個基點，為2012年以來最寬。路透較早的市場報價顯示，英國10年期殖利率上升10個基點至5.378%，創2007年7月以來新高，20年及30年期分別為5.895%與5.948%。英國債務管理局發行£50億、票息4.625%的2030年5月到期公債，得標殖利率4.786%，為2023年10月以來同類標售最高。稍晚，市場對英國央行截至2027年底的累計升息預期增至110個基點，高於週三的89個基點。

RICS房價調查淨值由−29改善至−28，購屋需求與交易量也有所回升，但回報房價下跌的受訪者仍多於回報上漲者。Tarrant Parsons指出，融資成本與房產稅的不確定性，仍可能打斷房市企穩。Moneyfacts的兩年期固定房貸利率為5.67%，高於戰前的4.83%。

Lagarde否定Mélenchon取消債務提案，認為法律、技術及財務都不可行。Bloomberg Economics的Jean Dalbard與Bhargavi Sakthivel估法國殖利率升75個基點，就可吃掉低票息取消的節省；法國央行穩態收入每年可能少€67億、GDP 0.2%，降低未來股利稅收。這是提案評估，非已取消或整段利差原因。

歐元資金市場的流動性也逐漸收緊。隨央行持債規模下降，超額準備金由2022年的€4.75兆降至€2.13兆。12月Euribor與ESTR利差擴大至16.5個基點，6月約為13個基點，Citadel與Schonfeld均參與押注利差擴大的交易。目前尚未出現立即性的準備金短缺；銀行若增加向歐洲央行再融資，可減少在貨幣市場借款，進而壓低ESTR。不過，ING的Benjamin Schroeder指出，銀行擔心向央行借款被視為財務較弱，仍傾向市場融資。因此，即使準備金總量尚充足，其在銀行間的分布也開始影響資金價格。

日本央行的Kazuyuki Masu認為，基礎通膨已接近2%，金融情勢仍寬鬆，因此支持利率繼續朝1.1%至2.5%的中性區間調整。他提醒，燃料、化學品、運輸與肥料漲價，可能使食品及商品物價壓力延續。不過，他在下午記者會並未預期基礎通膨會快速、大幅超標，也沒有明確支持加快升息；他強調，日銀將獨立判斷，不會依循Bessent的偏好決策。

利率上升已影響日本不動產的投資取捨。PGIM的David Fassbender表示，借款成本提高，加上不動產相對日本公債的收益溢價縮小，使公司更審慎挑選辦公室與多戶住宅，但融資仍容易取得。PGIM今年預計在亞太不動產投入逾$20億，至少一半位於日本；其日本資產管理規模約$30億。目前約一半的日本投資資金流向資料中心，除東京與大阪既有項目外，至少還在洽談一案。若租金持續成長、升息符合原先預期，投資仍有支撐；升息若更快或幅度更大，才需要重新評估報酬。

惠譽的Jeremy Zook預期，名目經濟成長與稅收增加將抵銷財政擴張，日本債務占GDP比率可再下降五年，之後趨於穩定。A評等、展望穩定之下，升降評風險大致平衡；高市17項優先政策如何分配預算，以及初級財政收支的走向，將是後續觀察重點。

土耳其央行則維持政策利率37%，符合19名受訪分析師幾乎一致的預期。央行承認基礎物價壓力降溫、需求偏弱，但8月通膨仍達31.5%，能源風險使其暫不降息。里拉兌美元在48.49附近、變動不大，銀行股一度下跌1.2%。

## AI借款改變跨國與券別相對價值

亞洲科技債與美國同業的評價差距已明顯縮小。SK Hynix的2031年到期債殖利率僅比Amazon高9個基點，差距約為去年的三分之一；騰訊2031年到期債的利差與Apple相當，儘管穆迪評等低四級。同為Aa3的台積電，利差比Meta窄近20個基點，與兩年前寬約25個基點的情況相反。摩根大通的新興市場與美國公司債利差差距，也由歷史上的30至50個基點收窄至數個基點。

摩根大通的Yang-Myung Hong與Alisa Meyers認為，新興市場投資級債券供給有序，加上亞洲及中東本地買盤支持，有助解釋利差收斂。Ninety One的Nazmeera Moola則指出，晶片製造商的實際產出較容易觀察。不過，Aegon的Euart MacKerron認為亞洲科技債利差已過窄，因此完全未持有。隨著中國網路業者的資本支出逐步落實，以及三星、SK等韓國企業合計$8,800億的投資承諾推進，未來發債供給未必仍然稀少。

中國上市科技公司透過股權籌資逾$410億，發債約$150億；美國同業則分別為$1,030億與約$3,800億，融資結構明顯不同。中國以阿里巴巴的$100億配售領先，其他籌資企業包括Z. AI、MiniMax及Shanghai Biren。Jefferies估計，第2季中國雲端業者資本支出占營收25%，美國為33%。海外債券買盤較有限、美元融資昂貴，使中國企業即使面臨股權稀釋，仍看重股本融資的彈性。主要中國與香港科技指數成分股中，約三分之一明年可能出現負自由現金流。

法國巴黎銀行Viktor Hjort團隊預期，債市可能由供給不足轉向過剩：明年大型雲端業者發債可能達$4,000億，整體固定收益淨供給則創紀錄達$3.7兆。團隊預估，到2026年底，歐元投資級利差將擴大6個基點、美元投資級擴大7個基點，但認為短期供給仍可被市場消化。

大額發債也可能改變同一公司的券別相對價值。Marty Fridson在路透的分析採用8月21日價格：Oracle發行額$10億、票息4.375%的2055年4月到期債，殖利率為7.67%；較新的$35億、票息5.95%的2055年9月到期債，殖利率則為7.86%，信用利差寬22個基點。Alphabet、Meta與Nvidia規模較大的新券，也有15至22個基點的殖利率或利差溢價。這些$35億至$40億的單券規模位居投資級債前1.5%，市場承接大量供給的壓力，可能超過大券通常享有的流動性優勢。

Oracle盤後公布的雲端成長超出預期，帶動股價上漲約6%，但營收改善仍須與資金需求一起衡量。財報公布前，市場估計其2027財年資本支出接近$930億，自由現金流為負$466億。設備成本也在增加：華為在三個月內將Ascend 950DT建議售價提高約60%，至CN¥25萬、約$37,300；DeepSeek計畫在內蒙古使用至少16萬顆。

股權與跨境投資則持續提供其他資金。阿聯計畫在既有€340億投資之外，再向德國AI、能源及國防領域投入€400億，其中約€100億位於巴伐利亞。Boring Co.則以$230億估值完成$30億D輪募資，投資人包括阿聯及關係方，以及Human Capital、Vy、Valor、Sequoia、A16Z與Temasek，資金將支持阿聯逾150公里的隧道項目。

## 再融資前進，貸款人取得具體保障

Sophos由高盛安排的再融資方案，擬加入多項債權保障：omniblocker限制借款人給予特定債權人優惠；Serta條款防止透過非比例債務交換，使原債權順位下降；Pluralsight條款則限制智慧財產移出債權人可追索的範圍。約$16.7億美元貸款的初步定價為基準利率加5至5.25個百分點、發行價97美分，另有€3.5億貸款。公司也將投入$3億私人次順位實物付息（PIK）融資及$9,800萬現金，以降低槓桿。

既有$21億、2027年3月到期貸款的交易價格為98.5。新方案仍屬寬鬆契約貸款（covenant-lite）：上述保障針對特定交易，並非要求公司定期通過獲利或槓桿測試。知情人士表示，Thoma Bravo尚未進行負債管理交易，貸款人是在要求較高利差及折價發行的同時，預先防堵可能損害債權的操作。

Merlin取得£6.57億融資承諾，新增London Eye、SEA Life London、Shrek's Adventure!及UK Dungeons等資產作為擔保，新融資將與既有有擔保債務享有同等順位。機構投資人已承諾全額資金，但仍保留部分額度供既有債權人參與；交易預計年底前完成，仍須滿足交割條件。這筆融資將處理2027年到期、合計約$8.4億等值的美元與歐元無擔保債務，之後公司還有約$49億有擔保債務於2029至2032年到期。

Merlin上半年營收為£8.14億，以固定匯率計算減少約1%，EBITDA則增加0.8%至£1.7億。英國消費信心疲弱及第2季炎熱天氣，壓低部分景點人流；北美新開的Legoland設施則提供支撐。Blackstone、CPP Investments與Kirkbi支持公司的策略，新擔保資產也使再融資不必完全仰賴營收立即大幅反彈。

Emeria的主要貸款人已進入保密協商。Partners Group與TA擬投入約€3.5億新資金，高於先前的€2億；方案可能將€36億債務中的一部分，包括有擔保債務，移至控股公司，在不削減有擔保債權本金的情況下，降低營運公司的槓桿。債權人則要求取得英國業務作為擔保。受總體環境、資產處分及客戶流失影響，公司上半年虧損近乎倍增至€1.08億。部分債務於2027年到期，另有約€20億有擔保貸款於2028年到期；Partners已下調持股估值。目前仍在談判，不能視為重整條件已定案。

知情人士表示，由SBI主導、包括Union Bank與NaBFID的銀行團，同意提供Vodafone Idea約$35億貸款。條件包括Birla在接近10年的貸款期間維持董事長職務，以及提供違約時的還款保證；部分資金將用於升級網路，與Airtel及Jio競爭。公司截至6月當季虧損₹375億，低於預期。先前約₹3,700億欠款轉為股權，使政府持股升至48.99%，也為貸款人在公司持續虧損之際提供支持。

其他企業交易也有進展。Enbridge同意以約$26億向Blackstone收購Tallgrass原油事業，較先前約$20億的管線收購討論更進一步。Intesa股東批准發行新股，以支持€354億的Monte dei Paschi收購案，但交易尚未完成。MercadoLibre已完成的$10億、2036年到期優先無擔保債發行，則補充揭露票息為5.850%、殖利率為6.139%，並非另一筆新籌資。

## 主權融資選擇性改善，本地流動性改變

薩爾瓦多債券自Dan Katz在7月底發表談話以來，報酬率達2.3%，居拉美主權債之首，利差也降至2010年以來最低。最新工作層級協議涵蓋$14億援助計畫中，原定2025年9月及2026年3月完成的兩次審查；IMF董事會批准後，可撥付約$1.4億。協議進展包括Chivo改由私人持有多數股權，以及證明首次審查後取得的比特幣來自私人捐贈、而非公共資源，但捐贈者身分未公開。

經濟活動在5月與6月均年增5.2%，花旗指出建築業是支撐之一。然而，原定2026年初實施的退休金改革已延至明年，政府對私人退休基金所欠利息的四年寬限期，也將在2027年屆滿。薩爾瓦多利差目前為271個基點，相較之下，同級的阿根廷接近500個基點，迦納為218個基點。PPM的Matthew Graves認為，以目前評價而言，市場留給政策失誤的空間已不大。

塞內加爾部分債券持有人已聘請White & Case，並正籌組代表近$50億債券的債權人委員會。目前只是準備談判，尚未議定債務減免，政府表明將付款的立場也未改變。

匈牙利重申採用歐元的目標，則支持Schroders在本幣與硬通貨債券上的趨同交易。James Ringer偏好長天期債，著眼於政府爭取2030年達到加入條件。殖利率約5.5%，比今年高點低近2個百分點，福林兌歐元已升值5.6%；不過，達標目標並不等於已確定加入歐元區的日期。

中國10年期公債殖利率維持約1.68%。報導以週三美債水準比較，兩者差距達317個基點，創2002年有資料以來紀錄；人民幣兌美元在6.7075附近，變動不大。貸款需求疲弱促使銀行買債，加上資本管制、7月底外資持債占比僅4.6%，使中國債市對跨境資金外流的敏感度較低。

東南亞近期標售需求較弱。馬來西亞8月底發行2046年到期公債，投標倍數為1.63，居今年第二低；泰國9月2日的2036年到期公債為1.13倍，創5月以來最低。菲律賓五年期公債投標倍數為2013年以來最低，印尼一般公債收到IDR66兆、約$37.7億投標，則是7月7日以來最少。Western Asset的Desmond Fu與Aberdeen的Fesa Wibawa認為，利率、能源及供給壓力，比基本面崩潰更能解釋需求轉弱。但泰國8月通膨達2.53%、印尼達3.19%，也使原先的通膨降溫預期受到挑戰。

印尼債市仍連續第四個月吸引外資，只是流入速度低於6月的$13億。印尼盾自6月低點回升逾3.5%，政策官員也強調穩定，使Invesco與PPM降低減碼幅度。Aberdeen的Kieran Curtis則仍擔心，Danantara的收入與支出未納入一般預算揭露，增加財政透明度風險。

印度盧比連續第三天下跌，貶值0.3%至95.44。國有銀行賣出美元，可能是代表央行干預，但交易員表示力道弱於上週。印度央行也連續第二天透過9月與12月的美元賣出、買回換匯交易回收盧比。一年期遠期隱含年化升水在兩天內提高近30個基點至3.37%，創5月底以來新高，匯率操作已直接反映在避險成本上。

智利提出30項市場措施，將首度允許退休基金參與附買回及附賣回交易，同時簡化中型企業發債程序，減少外資所需文件與稅務負擔。退休基金持有約$450億政府債，占市場40%，另持有大量合格公司債。相較於近$1,100億政府債流通餘額，登記的日均成交額僅$2.7億；九檔債券占成交量80%，另有11檔今年完全未交易。

新制度可讓基金以債券取得短期資金，增加交易商可運用的券源，但借入的現金不得用於買股票。基金也可反向提供現金、收取債券擔保，在短期銀行工具之外增加投資選擇。配套還包括造市商制度，以及央行就擔保品與違約淨額結算所進行的工作。BICE的Marco Gallardo預期，流動性溢價將逐步下降，而非市場立即全面重估。

結算基礎設施方面，Fnality任命Jon Cunliffe為英國董事長；Jochen Metzger加入歐洲董事會，預計接任董事長，Ron Berndsen也加入該董事會。其英鎊系統已運用央行貨幣餘額進行結算，美元與歐元系統則仍待監管批准。

## CPI、政策指引與IMF批准是下一步

市場預估9月11日公布的CPI月增0.4%，高於前期的0.1%；核心CPI預估月增0.2%，年增率由2.5%降至2.4%。密西根大學消費者信心初值將提供最新通膨預期，接著是9月16日的聯準會決策、經濟預測與記者會。9月30日PCE將調整法律服務、軟體及投資顧問服務的衡量方式，經濟學家預期這會壓低測得的通膨率，因此仍須考慮新方法對本次PPI細項的影響。

歐洲央行官員認為10月仍可能升息，部分則傾向等待12月的新預測，並認為市場反映的另外三次升息偏積極。市場普遍預期日本央行9月18日將升息25個基點至1.25%，但Masu支持持續正常化的同時，並未表現出加快行動的急迫性。土耳其10月22日會議則可能朝相反方向調整：QNB的Erkin Isik認為，唯有通膨未明顯惡化、能源價格回落，才有機會降息100個基點。

Katz將於9月17日訪問薩爾瓦多。若IMF董事會在10月初前批准合併審查，僅付息債券的票息將由4%降回0.25%。摩根士丹利預期批准能及時完成，但2月大選前推動退休金改革的難度更高。即使順利取得撥款並調降票息，政府仍須面對更大規模的退休金償付義務。

long_thesis.english_markdown:
## Oil surge overwhelms strong long-bond demand

Treasuries fell sharply as oil strengthened the case for Fed tightening and the first expanded buyback accepted less than its cap. The 2-year yield rose 13 basis points to 4.56%, the 5-year 14 to 4.75%, the 10-year 12 to 4.95% and the 30-year 9 to 5.37%. Shorter maturities bore the greater adjustment, narrowing 2s30s by 4 basis points to 81.

Brent reached $108.85 and WTI $103.78. Headline PPI showed renewed energy pressure; monthly core missed forecasts, but airfares and hospital costs pointed to stronger PCE components. Claims remained steady, offering little new labor-market reason to tolerate inflation. The ECB's completed hike and higher projections reinforced the international pressure.

Buyers had not abandoned duration. The $22 billion long-bond auction cleared 2.7 basis points through the market with record-low dealer allocation. Treasury then bought $5.19 billion against a $6 billion maximum despite $10.5 billion offered, disappointing expectations for more official absorption. Good private bidding at high yields did not establish a ceiling on financing costs.

Ten-year real yields rose 9 basis points to 2.55%, more than the 3-basis-point breakeven increase to 2.40%. US HY spreads widened modestly, and municipals faced an especially sharp combination of new supply, low reinvestment and withdrawals. Credit remained accessible, but lenders demanded more yield, collateral or control from vulnerable borrowers.

## Fuel costs, steady claims and a selective buyback drive repricing

Iran threatened a more intense war and escalating counterstrikes if US attacks continued. The Wall Street Journal reported JD Vance and Marco Rubio warning Trump the conflict could last through his term, contrasting with his claim it would end immediately after the election. Persistent Hormuz attacks kept supply, rather than a sudden demand boom, central to oil.

Traders and Vortexa put product shipments through Hormuz around at least 1 million barrels daily versus about 4 million prewar, excluding LPG. Crude had recovered to roughly half its old level. Middle East–China tanker earnings approached $800,000 a day; US Gulf–Asia charter offers reached a record $29.5 million lump sum, almost $15 a barrel before extra war risk or delays.

US inventories offered some relief. Crude fell 0.391 million barrels versus a 1.6 million expected draw and 4.45 million previously. Gasoline rose 1.269 million instead of a forecast 1.4 million draw; distillates rose 2.087 million versus an expected 0.7 million decline. After the fixed-income close, Saudi Arabia told OPEC August production fell to its lowest since 1990, while Houthis advanced toward Red Sea areas bordering Bab el-Mandeb. Those later reports affect the supply outlook, not the completed rates move.

August PPI rose 0.4% monthly as expected, after revised July +0.1% and June −0.1%. Annual growth accelerated to 5.4% from revised 4.8%, above 5.3% consensus. Goods rose 1.1%, energy 4.2% and diesel 24.1%, while services added 0.1%. Ex-food-and-energy PPI rose 0.2%, below the 0.3% forecast and revised July 0.3%; annual core rose to 4.6% from revised 4.3%, matching expectations. Ex-food, energy and trade services rose 0.3% monthly and 4.7% annually, after 0.4% and 4.7%.

The PCE-related detail was less benign. Airfares and inpatient/outpatient hospital costs rose strongly; legal services gained 1.7%, most in records since 2009. Bloomberg Economics raised its August PCE assessment after hospital and airfare surprises. Electronic components/accessories rose 3.4%, computers/equipment 0.2%, construction costs barely changed and wholesale/retail margins fell 0.2%. Some intermediaries were absorbing costs even as particular services and AI inputs became dearer.

Initial claims were 206,000 through September 5 versus 205,000 expected and an upward-revised 207,000 previously. The four-week average fell 1,500 to 206,000. Continuing claims through August 29 eased to 1.774 million from revised 1.775 million, below 1.780 million consensus, with insured unemployment at 1.2%.

Housing was weaker. Existing-home sales fell 2% to a 3.98 million annual pace, as expected, from 4.06 million, the slowest in over a year. Median prices still rose 1.6% annually to $429,100. Listings increased 5.9% to 1.62 million, highest since November 2019, and supply reached 4.9 months, highest in over a decade. Sales fell in the South, Midwest and Northeast and held in the West; the South declined 1.6% to 1.84 million. First-time buyers were 30% versus July's 29%; affordability improved 3.5% annually but remained historically poor.

Freddie Mac's 30-year rate rose to 6.76% from 6.71%, versus 6.35% a year ago and highest since June 2025. Fifteen-year rates rose to 6.09% from 6.04%. NAR's Lawrence Yun said jobs and wages still supported buyers. Barclays noted falling residential construction employment but record total construction jobs in August as nonresidential specialty and engineering grew. Hyperscalers spent over 90% of operating cash flow on AI; it judged another 50–75 basis points of financing cost unlikely to reverse plans.

Late swaps put September Fed hike odds near 70%, fully pricing a move by October. The 30-year auction meanwhile awarded at 5.308%, 2.7 basis points through, the second-largest through in five years. Dealers took only 2.2%, lowest in any conventional Treasury auction. The buyback then stopped at $5.19 billion, unlike all previous 25 operations in the band that filled $2 billion caps; bonds cheapened against swaps, especially 20s.

TD's Molly Brooks thought Treasury unusually selective. In a post-close interview, Bessent said it bought only at attractive prices and argued holders wanted to retain long bonds. Rejecting expensive offers need not mean too few willing sellers. The market nevertheless had expected more purchases.

Trump separately proposed $5,000 for adult citizens if Republicans retain Congress on November 3. Reuters estimated 240 million eligible and $1.2 trillion cost. Vance suggested tariffs, against CBO fiscal-year-to-date receipts of $167 billion and a $2.1 trillion deficit. Congress must authorize it; Republicans rejected an earlier proposal, and Ted Cruz suggested a work-linked tax refund. Muted initial futures reaction argues against making this pledge the day's main cause, though its scale adds fiscal uncertainty.

At 4 p.m., muni 10-year benchmarks rose 15 basis points to 3.69%, highest since April 2025, and 30-years 14 to 4.89%, highest since February 2011. Alabama's Toll Road, Bridge and Tunnel Authority sold about $3.8 billion for Mobile River, and New York transit about $778 million backed by luxury-property taxes. JPMorgan cited supply, low reinvestment and tax trading, with roughly $460 million Wednesday outflows, largest since April 2025.

## ECB hikes; other central banks weigh how far to follow energy

The ECB unanimously raised deposits 25 basis points to 2.5%, its second hike since the war began. New inflation forecasts were 3% in 2026, 2.5% in 2027 and 2.1% in 2028, with headline and core revised higher in the latter years. Growth rose to 0.9%. Lagarde said broad Q2 expansion likely continued in Q3 and energy would gradually reach food and core.

Downside growth risk remained, while August headline 3.3% coexisted with easing underlying prices, services and wages. People familiar said officials expected more hikes but viewed three further market-priced moves as potentially excessive. No sequence was promised.

German 10-year yields rose 6 basis points to 3.50%, highest since 2009; 2-years reached 3.21% after as much as +14. France's spread reached 91 intraday, widest since 2012. An earlier Reuters snapshot put UK 10s at 5.378%, up 10 and highest since July 2007, with 20s/30s at 5.895%/5.948%. The DMO sold £5 billion of 4.625% May 2030 debt at 4.786%, highest comparable auction since October 2023. Later BOE pricing reached 110 basis points through end-2027 versus 89 Wednesday.

RICS house-price balance improved to −28 from −29, with demand and volumes better but still more falling-price reports. Tarrant Parsons saw stabilization threatened by financing and property-tax uncertainty. Moneyfacts' two-year fixed rate was 5.67%, versus 4.83% before the war.

Lagarde rejected Mélenchon's cancellation proposal as legally, technically and financially unsound. Bloomberg Economics' Jean Dalbard and Bhargavi Sakthivel estimated that just 75 basis points of higher French yields could erase savings on low-coupon canceled bonds. Lost steady-state Bank of France income could reach €6.7 billion annually, 0.2% of GDP, reducing future dividends and taxes. These assess a proposal, not enacted cancellation or the entire spread move.

Euro liquidity is tightening too. Excess reserves fell to €2.13 trillion from €4.75 trillion in 2022 as holdings ran down. December Euribor–ESTR traded at 16.5 basis points versus June's 13, with Citadel and Schonfeld active in widening trades. No immediate reserve shortage existed. More ECB refinancing could reduce bank money-market borrowing and weigh on ESTR, but ING's Benjamin Schroeder said stigma kept banks favoring market funds, making distribution important before aggregate scarcity.

BOJ's Kazuyuki Masu favored further hikes toward the 1.1%–2.5% neutral range because underlying inflation was near 2% and conditions accommodative. Fuel, chemicals, shipping and fertilizer could extend goods/food pressure. At his afternoon briefing he did not foresee a sharp underlying overshoot or clearly endorse faster sequencing, and emphasized independent BOJ judgment rather than Bessent's preferences.

PGIM's David Fassbender said higher debt costs and smaller premiums over JGBs made office and multifamily purchases more selective, although finance was readily available. The firm expects over $2 billion Asia-Pacific property investment this year, at least half Japan, where it manages about $3 billion. Around half Japanese capital now goes to data centers, including Tokyo/Osaka sites and at least one more pursued. Rent growth and an expected policy path limit damage; faster/larger hikes would change underwriting.

Fitch's Jeremy Zook expects Japanese debt/GDP to decline another five years as nominal growth and taxes offset fiscal expansion, then stabilize. Risks are balanced at A/stable; the budget composition and primary path across Takaichi's 17 priorities matter.

Turkey held 37%, matching near-unanimous expectations among 19 analysts. It acknowledged slower underlying prices, August 31.5% inflation and weak demand, but energy blocked easing. The lira was little changed at 48.49; bank shares initially fell as much as 1.2%.

## AI borrowing shifts relative value across countries and securities

SK Hynix 2031s yielded just 9 basis points over Amazon, one-third of last year's gap. Tencent 2031 spreads matched Apple's despite Moody's four-notch rating difference. Aa3-rated TSMC traded nearly 20 inside equally rated Meta, reversing a roughly 25 premium two years ago. JPMorgan's EM–US corporate spread gap narrowed to a few basis points from a historical 30–50.

JPMorgan's Yang-Myung Hong and Alisa Meyers cited orderly EM IG issuance and local Asian/Middle Eastern anchors; Ninety One's Nazmeera Moola emphasized chipmakers' observable output. Aegon's Euart MacKerron instead found Asian tech too tight and held none. Chinese internet capex and maturities, plus Korea's $880 billion conglomerate commitment including Samsung/SK, mean future supply need not stay scarce.

Listed Chinese tech raised over $41 billion in equity versus around $15 billion bonds, compared with US $103 billion and about $380 billion. Alibaba's $10 billion placement led, alongside Z. AI, MiniMax and Shanghai Biren. Jefferies put Q2 Chinese cloud capex at 25% of sales versus US 33%. A narrower offshore base and expensive dollars favor equity flexibility despite dilution; roughly one-third of major mainland/Hong Kong tech-gauge companies face negative free cash flow next year.

BNP's Viktor Hjort team forecast a shift from undersupply toward excess issuance, with $400 billion hyperscaler bonds next year and $3.7 trillion record net fixed-income supply. It sees end-2026 euro IG spreads 6 basis points wider and dollar IG 7 wider, while still judging near-term supply absorbable. Those are forecasts, not today's changes.

Marty Fridson's Reuters analysis used August 21 prices: Oracle's $1 billion 4.375% April 2055 bond yielded 7.67%, versus 7.86% on the newer $3.5 billion 5.95% September 2055, with a 22-basis-point wider spread. Larger newer Alphabet, Meta and Nvidia issues carried 15–22-basis-point yield/spread premiums. At $3.5 billion–$4 billion, such bonds sit in the top 1.5% by IG size; absorption can outweigh the usual liquidity benefit.

Oracle's cloud growth then beat forecasts in extended equity trading, lifting shares about 6%. That is revenue evidence, not a resolved funding gap. Pre-release fiscal-2027 estimates were almost $93 billion capex and −$46.6 billion free cash flow. Huawei separately raised suggested Ascend 950DT prices roughly 60% over three months to CN¥250,000/$37,300; DeepSeek plans at least 160,000 for Inner Mongolia.

Other capital remains available. UAE plans €40 billion in German AI, energy and defense, around €10 billion Bavaria, on top of €34 billion already invested. Boring Co. secured $3 billion Series D at $23 billion valuation, backed by UAE/affiliates with Human Capital, Vy, Valor, Sequoia, A16Z and Temasek. It supports over 150 kilometers of UAE tunnels, not another public-bond issue.

## Lenders obtain specific protections as refinancing advances

Sophos's Goldman-led proposal now includes an omniblocker against selective creditor deals, Serta protection against subordinating non-pro-rata exchanges and Pluralsight protection against transferring intellectual property beyond claims. It comprises roughly $1.67 billion loans at benchmark plus 5–5.25 percentage points and 97 cents, plus €350 million. A $300 million junior private PIK piece and $98 million cash also aim to reduce leverage.

The $2.1 billion March 2027 loan traded at 98.5. The package remains covenant-lite: blockers address particular transactions rather than recurring leverage/earnings tests. People familiar said Thoma Bravo had not conducted a liability-management exercise. Lenders want prospective protection alongside higher margins and discounted issuance.

Merlin obtained £657 million loan commitments with extra security from the London Eye, SEA Life London, Shrek's Adventure! and UK Dungeons. Debt ranks alongside existing secured obligations; institutions committed the full amount with some reserved for existing holders. Conditional closing is expected by year-end. It addresses $840 million-equivalent unsecured dollar/euro 2027 maturities, ahead of roughly $4.9 billion secured due 2029–2032.

First-half revenue was £814 million, down about 1% at constant FX, EBITDA up 0.8% to £170 million. Weak UK confidence and hot Q2 weather hurt some visits, while new Legoland attractions helped North America. Blackstone, CPP Investments and Kirkbi supported the strategy; the new assets back refinancing without requiring a strong current revenue rebound.

Emeria's biggest lenders entered NDA talks over about €350 million sponsor cash from Partners Group/TA, up from €200 million. Some of €3.6 billion liabilities, including secured debt, could move to a holding company, lowering operating leverage without secured write-offs. Creditors seek British-business collateral. First-half loss of €108 million nearly doubled amid macro pressure, disposals and client losses; some debt is due 2027 and roughly €2 billion secured term debt in 2028. Partners reduced its valuation. Terms remain changeable, not agreed restructuring.

People familiar said an SBI-led group, including Union Bank and NaBFID, agreed about $3.5 billion for Vodafone Idea. Conditions include Birla remaining chairman for almost the 10-year term and default repayment guarantees. Funds partly improve competition with Airtel and Jio. June-quarter loss was ₹37.5 billion, less than expected; conversion of about ₹370 billion dues to equity lifted government ownership to 48.99%, supporting lenders despite continued losses.

Enbridge agreed to buy Tallgrass's crude business from Blackstone for about $2.6 billion, advancing beyond earlier $2 billion pipeline talks. Intesa shareholders approved shares for its €35.4 billion Monte dei Paschi bid, advancing but not closing it. MercadoLibre's already completed $1 billion 2036 senior unsecured sale now has a 5.850% coupon and 6.139% yield—additional terms, not another raise.

## Sovereign access improves selectively as local liquidity changes

El Salvador bonds returned 2.3% since Dan Katz's late-July comments, best among Latin sovereigns, and spreads hit their lowest since 2010. The staff agreement covers overdue September 2025/March 2026 reviews of a $1.4 billion program, releasing about $140 million upon board approval. Progress included private majority ownership of Chivo and documenting that post-first-review Bitcoin came from private donations, not public resources; donors were unidentified.

Activity grew 5.2% annually in both May and June, with Citi citing construction. Pension reform due early 2026 now moves to next year; a four-year interest grace period to private pension funds expires in 2027. Spreads of 271 basis points compare with nearly 500 for similarly rated Argentina and 218 for Ghana. PPM's Matthew Graves saw little room for error at these valuations.

Some Senegal holders appointed White & Case while finalizing a creditor committee for almost $5 billion of notes. This organizes talks without agreed relief or changing the stated intention to pay. Hungary reaffirmed euro ambitions, supporting Schroders' local/hard-currency convergence position. James Ringer favors long maturities as it seeks criteria by 2030. Yields around 5.5% are nearly 2 percentage points below this year's peak and the forint is up 5.6% against the euro; no entry date is agreed.

China's 10-year held around 1.68%. The comparison with Wednesday's US yield produced a reported record 317-basis-point gap in data since 2002. The yuan was little changed at 6.7075. Weak loans and bank buying support bonds; controls and foreign ownership of only 4.6% at July-end limit external outflow sensitivity.

Regional auctions were weaker: Malaysia's end-August 2046 covered 1.63, second-lowest this year; Thailand's September 2 2036 covered 1.13, weakest since May. Philippine five-year cover was weakest since 2013, and Indonesian conventional bids IDR66 trillion/$3.77 billion, lowest since July 7. Western Asset's Desmond Fu and Aberdeen's Fesa Wibawa cited yields, energy and supply more than collapsing fundamentals, although Thai 2.53% and Indonesian 3.19% August inflation challenged disinflation hopes.

Indonesia still drew foreigners for a fourth month, slower than June's $1.3 billion. Invesco and PPM reduced underweights as the rupiah recovered over 3.5% from June and policymakers emphasized stability. Aberdeen's Kieran Curtis remained concerned about Danantara revenue/spending outside normal budget reporting.

India's rupee fell 0.3% to 95.44, a third decline, while state banks sold dollars likely for RBI, reportedly less aggressively than last week. RBI used September/December sell-buy swaps for a second day to drain rupees; one-year annualized implied forwards rose almost 30 basis points in two days to 3.37%, highest since late May. Proposed tools have become actual hedging-cost changes.

Chile will allow pension funds into repos and reverse repos for the first time, within 30 measures including easier midsize issuance and reduced foreign-investor paperwork/taxes. Funds own about $45 billion of Treasuries, 40% of the market, plus much eligible corporate debt. Daily registered sovereign turnover is only $270 million against nearly $110 billion outstanding; nine bonds account for 80%, and 11 have not traded this year.

Repos release cash and securities to dealers; borrowed cash cannot buy equities. Reverse repos provide secured alternatives to short bank instruments. A market-maker program and central-bank collateral/default-netting work support the change. BICE's Marco Gallardo expects gradual liquidity-premium reductions, not immediate market-wide repricing.

Fnality appointed Jon Cunliffe UK chair, Jochen Metzger to its European board and expected chair, and Ron Berndsen to that board. Sterling settlement already uses central-bank-money balances; dollar/euro systems still need approval.

## CPI, policy guidance and IMF approval are the next milestones

September 11 CPI consensus is +0.4% monthly after +0.1%, core +0.2% and annual core 2.4% from 2.5%. Preliminary Michigan adds expectations before September 16 Fed decisions, projections and press conference. September 30 PCE measurement changes to legal services, software and investment advice are expected to lower measured inflation; strong PPI components cannot be mapped mechanically into the old calculation.

ECB officials see October as possible, some preferring December's projections, while judging three more priced hikes aggressive. BOJ's September 18 quarter-point move to 1.25% is expected; Masu supported continued normalization without urgency. Turkey's October 22 meeting contrasts: QNB's Erkin Isik sees a 100-basis-point cut only if inflation does not worsen significantly and energy retreats.

Katz visits El Salvador September 17. IMF board approval of combined reviews by early October would restore interest-only-note coupons to 0.25% from 4%. Morgan Stanley expects timely approval, but pension reform is harder before February's election. Immediate disbursement and coupon relief would still leave the larger pension issue unresolved.

overall_summary.headline: Oil surge drives Treasury selloff despite strong long-bond bidding
overall_summary.session_narrative: The 10-year yield rose 12 basis points to 4.95%, including a 9-basis-point increase in real yields. Monthly core PPI was softer than forecast, but energy, airfares and hospital costs kept the inflation outlook uncomfortable; steady claims offered little labor-market relief. Treasury accepted $5.19 billion in its expanded buyback against a $6 billion cap, following a $22 billion long-bond auction that cleared 2.7 basis points through the market. Outside rates, new Sophos protections, Merlin collateral and Emeria sponsor talks showed how financing remained available on increasingly specific terms.
overall_summary.summary: Treasury yields rose 9–14 basis points as Brent reached $108.85 and swaps put September Fed hike odds near 70%. A strong 30-year auction could not offset a selectively filled buyback or the renewed inflation threat. The ECB raised rates, while corporate borrowers continued refinancing with more expensive or better-protected debt.
